exact_statement: The A058 v1 anchored transfer remains valid at its private-bit/disjoint-shared-block hypotheses. When the first two private bits are identified, coefficient pairs v_T(S),v_{T xor {1,2}}(S) merge coherently. With ell=v^2, Q=v^2+v_partner^2, P=(v+v_partner)^2, delta=P-Q, the exact bit ledger is H(P)=H(old)-H_ell(T|Y)-D(P||Q)-sum_Y delta(Y)log2 Q(Y), both laws normalized, 0<=D<=1 and 0<=H_ell(T|Y)<=1. Influence change is sum_Y delta(Y)(|phi(T)|+|S|)-2Pr_ell({1,2} subset T). No finite C bounds the signed cross-surprisal, or positive coherent entropy increment, by shared-anchor influence in all such Boolean compositions: quadratic bent cores give R=k, Delta H=k-2, I_anchor=1 and Delta I_data=k/2 for every k>=1. Nor is latent posterior<=C I_anchor: an off-diagonal exceptional outer with identical literal children gives posterior=1 and I_anchor=0. The exact deficit transport retains both credits and the influence change; its universal sign/payment remains open.
